page.overview:
Who is Mosh?

Mosh is a very large man, comparable to Jean Bart in size. His hair is light-colored and arranged in a ponytail, with a prominent bang covering the left side of his face. He wears a feathered coat adorned with spikes at the shoulders (similar to Kid's own captain coat before the timeskip) and a shirt with the picture of a guitar printed on it.

Not much is known about Mosh's personality yet. He is, however, loyal to his captain and attempted to protect him from Big Mom.

Mosh wields a katana with a long handle.

Mosh witnessed his captain fight Big Mom on the Live Floor. When it looked like Kid was done for, Mosh was one of the crewmembers who attempted to defend his captain from Big Mom, but he only managed to get hit by Hera's lightning technique in the process. He later cheered on for Kid after the latter got up and was able to significantly injure Big Mom.
